model_meta.system_name: Guide Vane Adjustment Assembly with Bending-Failure Link
model_meta.description: Inferred concept model of an inlet guide-vane adjustment assembly using linked levers and a common adjusting element, with a bending-failure arm that ruptures above a bending-moment threshold while a first arm and bending element retain the vane.

subsystems.subsystem_name: Inlet guide vane and pivot axis
subsystems.description: Guide vane that turns about its pivot axis under the action of its lever; guide vanes can also serve as shut-off valves.
Lever extending from each corresponding guide-vane pivot axis and turning the vane; coupled to its link.

Illustrative single-link instance coupling a guide-vane lever to the common adjusting element, with a first arm and bending-element arm extending between its pivot couplings. The bending-element arm has a rupture region triggered above a threshold bending moment; the first arm withstands that moment. In the illustrated embodiment, a tension bolt fractures while the bending element holds the vane against freely moving in the flow.

parts.description: First link arm configured to withstand the threshold moment without rupturing.
Bending-element arm with rupture region configured to rupture above threshold bending moment.
Prestressed tension bolt with a defined rupture cross-section.
Bending element that retains the guide vane after tension-bolt fracture.

subsystems.description: Common element coupled through links to the guide-vane levers and configured to pivot the levers; one disclosed configuration is a coaxial adjusting ring.

item_flows.name: Link mechanical motion and positioning load
item_flows.notes: Couples the common adjusting element to the respective vane lever.

item_flows.name: Guide-vane rotation and turning moment
item_flows.notes: Mechanical rotational interaction at the guide-vane pivot axis through the guide-vane lever.

actions.name: Turn guide vane through adjustment linkage

steps.description: The common adjusting element pivots the link through its coupling.
The link transmits positioning force to the guide-vane lever.
The lever turns the corresponding guide vane about its pivot axis.
A bending moment above the defined threshold causes the tension bolt to break at its rupture cross-section.
The link's moment of inertia drops and load on the guide vane is relieved.
The bending element continues to hold the guide vane and prevents it from moving entirely freely in the flow.

requirements.statement: The bending-element arm rupture region shall rupture when bending moment applied to the link exceeds its threshold, while the first arm withstands that threshold without rupturing.
requirements.rationale: Claim 1; models the specifically claimed selective overload response.

requirements.statement: After the tension bolt breaks, the bending element shall hold the guide vane against moving entirely freely in the flow.
requirements.rationale: Description of bending-breaking link operation; preserves post-fracture holding function.
